title: The zia_pac_files resource: versions, pinning and status transitions

prose.text: The provider models one hosted PAC file as a parent with one tracked version at a time. Content is immutable per version, so most edits save a new version, and `pac_version` turns the resource from creating versions into selecting them.

prose.label: Data source.
prose.text: {{data-source-deployed-list}} The PAC file as a forwarding method is in [[zia.traffic-forwarding.pac]].
Whether a created file is live is disputed [[zia.traffic-forwarding.pac:create-vs-deploy]].

checks.do: Whether `pac_version` is declared, since a declared version pins an existing version and rejects content that does not match it exactly.
Whether a failed change hit the maximum version count, which needs `delete_version` on the save.
Whether a requested STAGE or UNSTAGED targets the currently deployed version, which the provider refuses.
Whether the version status was read back after a create before treating the file as live.

create-always-deployed.statement: On create the provider rejects any `pac_version_status` other than DEPLOYED, rejects a declared `pac_version`, and sends the create request with the status set to DEPLOYED; STAGE, LKG and UNSTAGED can only be applied to later versions.

quotes: pac_version_status must be DEPLOYED when creating a PAC file
pac_version cannot be declared when creating a PAC file
req.PACVersionStatus = "DEPLOYED"

content-validated-first.statement: The PAC content is sent to the service's validation endpoint before create and before a new version is saved; any validation error aborts the apply with the line and column messages, while warnings are only logged.

quotes: PAC content failed validation with %d error(s): %s
[WARN] PAC content validated with %d warning(s): %+v

update-clones-version.statement: When `pac_version` is not declared, changing `pac_content`, `name`, `description`, `domain` or `pac_url_obfuscated` saves a new version cloned from the currently tracked version and then applies the declared status; changing only `pac_commit_message` does not clone a version.

declared-version-pins.statement: When `pac_version` is declared it selects an existing version: a change to `name`, `description`, `domain` or `pac_url_obfuscated` is rejected, a `pac_content` change is accepted only when it exactly matches the selected version's content and is then not cloned, and a status-only change acts on the selected version without cloning.

quotes: if d.HasChange("pac_content") && !d.HasChanges("name", "description", "domain", "pac_url_obfuscated") {
pac_content must match the declared version's content exactly

status-transition-rules.statement: Before a status transition the provider reads the version and makes no call when the status and commit message already match; it rejects moving the currently deployed version to STAGE or UNSTAGED, and maps UNSTAGED to the UNSTAGE action, or to REMOVE_LKG when the version is the last known good.

quotes: already has status %s; no transition needed
// The service refuses to stage or unstage the currently deployed
action = "REMOVE_LKG"

action-body-is-commit-message.statement: The provider's status action passes the commit message to the SDK version-action call, and its comment says the action endpoint stores the request body as the version's commit message.

quotes: // endpoint stores the request body as the version's commit message, so the
pacfiles.UpdatePacFile(ctx, service, pacID, pacVersion, action, commitMessage, nil)

delete-version-for-capacity.statement: `delete_version` names a version to remove when a content change would exceed the maximum number of PAC file versions, and is used only when a new version is saved; the save error suggests setting it when the maximum was reached.

quotes: The version to remove when a content change would exceed the maximum number of PAC file versions. Only used when saving a new version.
(if the maximum number of versions was reached, set delete_version to remove one)

import-adopts-deployed.statement: Import accepts a numeric PAC file ID or a name, resolves the file through the deployed-state list or a by-name lookup, and adopts the file's deployed version as the tracked version.

quotes: // Adopt the deployed version as the tracked version.
resp, err := pacfiles.GetPacFileByName(ctx, service, id)

read-tracks-version.statement: Read refreshes the tracked version, and falls back to the file's deployed version only when the tracked version no longer exists, removing the resource from state only when the file itself is gone.

data-source-deployed-list.statement: The `zia_pac_files` data source lists PAC files in deployed state, including default and custom ones; `id` or `name` narrows it to one file, and `filter = "pac_content"` omits the content, including on a name lookup, which returns the full object and has it blanked.

quotes: List of PAC files in deployed state, including default and custom PAC files.
